en: I realize I'm not introducing myself at all.
zh: 我发现我完全没有介绍自己。

en: I'm 23 years old and I turned 24 in November.
zh: 我今年23岁，11月就满24岁了。

en: I am from Mallorca in Spain.
zh: 我来自西班牙的马略卡岛。

en: which is one of the Balearic Islands.
zh: 也就是Balearic Islands中的一个岛。

en: People are always very surprised when I say I'm from Mallorca because.
zh: 每次我说我来自马略卡岛，大家都会特别惊讶，因为

en: a lot of people go there for vacation.
zh: 很多人都会去那里度假。

en: But actually, my parents are also from Mallorca.
zh: 但其实，我爸妈也都是马略卡岛人。

en: They both grew up in Mallorca.
zh: 他们俩都是在马略卡岛长大的。

en: However, my mum is half Swedish.
zh: 不过，我妈妈有一半瑞典血统。

en: which is why I am partly Swedish from Stockholm.
zh: 所以我也有一部分来自斯德哥尔摩的瑞典血统。

en: I have two sisters and three stepbrothers.
zh: 我有两个姐妹，还有三个继兄弟。

en: My dad was previously married before my mum and had three boys.
zh: 我爸爸在娶我妈妈之前曾经结过婚，并且有三个儿子。

en: and then married my mum and had three girls.
zh: 后来他娶了我妈妈，又有了三个女儿。

en: I speak four languages.
zh: 我会说四种语言。

en: I speak Spanish, Swedish, English and a tiny bit of French.
zh: 我会说西班牙语、瑞典语、英语，还有一点点法语。

en: I do understand a lot of French though because I did study it in school for around six years.
zh: 不过我能听懂很多法语，因为我在学校学了大概六年法语。

en: I studied a bachelor in business administration in Madrid.
zh: 我在马德里读了工商管理本科。

en: I went to IE University and had the best time of my life.
zh: 我上的是IE University，那是我人生中最快乐的一段时光。

en: So what brings me to New York, you may ask.
zh: 那你可能会问，我为什么会来到纽约呢？

en: My university in Madrid opened a campus in New York.
zh: 我在马德里的大学在纽约开设了一个校区。

en: and so a bunch of us got offered the opportunity to fast track our bachelor.
zh: 所以我们当中有一批人获得了提前完成本科的机会，

en: and get started on our master's degree.
zh: 并且可以开始攻读硕士学位。

en: Luckily, my boyfriend also got offered the opportunity.
zh: 很幸运的是，我男朋友也得到了这个机会。

en: It's great to have him here.
zh: 有他在这里真的太好了。

en: I don't know what I would have done without him, honestly.
zh: 说真的，我不知道没有他我该怎么办。

en: Yeah, that brings me here to YouTube.
zh: 是的，这也就把我带到了YouTube。

en: YouTube has been my biggest dream.
zh: YouTube一直是我最大的梦想。

en: So you get an idea.
zh: 给你们一个概念。

en: My dad bought me the Canon G7X when I was like 13.
zh: 我大概13岁的时候，我爸爸给我买了Canon G7X。

en: He got me that camera because I wanted to become a vlogger.
zh: 他给我买那台相机，是因为我想成为一个vlogger。

en: I never got over my shyness and my fear of judgment.
zh: 但我一直没能克服自己的害羞和对被评价的恐惧。

en: That's why I love TikTok so much because it's such a easy platform to get started.
zh: 这也是为什么我这么喜欢TikTok，因为它是一个特别容易开始的平台。

en: Whereas I feel like Instagram and YouTube are a lot more daunting for different reasons.
zh: 但我觉得Instagram和YouTube因为不同的原因，会让人更有压力。

en: YouTube, I feel like it's a lot more personal.
zh: YouTube，我觉得它要私人化得多。

en: and Instagram is harder to get started because you already have that base of people you know,
zh: 而Instagram更难开始，因为你已经有了一批认识你的人，

en: that follow you from back home or whatever the case may be.
zh: 你知道，就是那些从老家就关注你的人，或者类似这种情况。

en: So you're a lot more afraid.
zh: 所以你会害怕得多。

en: or at least that was the case for me.
zh: 至少对我来说是这样。

en: But TikTok, you start from scratch and it's fast paced content.
zh: 但TikTok不一样，你是从零开始，而且内容节奏很快。

en: So no one really sits and watches you for long periods of time.
zh: 所以没有人真的会坐在那里长时间看着你。

en: I set my makeup with this One/Size spray.
zh: 我用这个One/Size定妆喷雾来定妆。

en: I've gotten so many people on the spray.
zh: 我已经安利了好多人用这个喷雾。

en: It's amazing. This's my makeup, I go for very natural makeup.
zh: 它真的很好用。这就是我的妆容，我一般会化很自然的妆。

en: and makeup I can do quickly because I'm a huge amateur.
zh: 而且是那种我能快速完成的妆，因为我真的超级业余。
